data.narrative:
Phaidra is a Series B AI & Software company founded by Jim Gao (ex-Google DeepMind) and Vedavyas Panneershelvam (AlphaGo engineer), with Katherine Hoffman leading operations. The company has raised $120M to date. The comparable universe comprises 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Figure AI, Reflection AI, Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, Together AI, and others) plus 1 public reference point (Palantir).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression, using the $120M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implies $228M. Peer-median analysis across the 7-company comp set yields a median valuation of $10.0B, with a range spanning $3.2B (low) to $39.0B (high). The peer set's wide dispersion reflects stage heterogeneity—Figure AI and Skild AI are Series C at $39.0B and $14.0B respectively, while Reflection AI and Together AI are Series A at $25.0B and $8.3B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $194M (low) to $11.5B (high), with a median of $5.1B. The wide spread reflects uncertainty around team-driven upside potential versus stage-implied valuation. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, product-market fit specificity, and the appropriate comparability weighting given the peer set's stage dispersion and varying business models.
